thread:
Tara: Starting Sprint 0 onboarding for Acadia Labs. Objectives: connect data feed, verify mappings, enable clinicians, and validate 30-day adoption signals. Primary contact = Omar (Acadia PM). Need owners and any immediate blockers.
Omar: Yep that's me. Internal owners: Priya (Ops), Marco (Data), Sarah (Security). Data residency note: EU-only for pilot.
Luis: SE here  will need a sample dataset & token for staging. Can we get a small subset (50 records) by EOD Thu?
Omar: I can share a CSV extract by Thu noon. Any schema preferences?
Luis: Prefer NDJSON with one JSON object per line; include patient_id, note_text, ts. If PHI present, mask before sending.
Bee: I'll lead enablement. Proposed training: one 45-min synchronous demo + 20-min office hours twice during pilot. Target clinicians: 10.
Hannah: Security note  we'll require SSO via SAML + proof of encryption-at-rest. Sarah will kick off a short intake. ETA 3-5 business days.
Tara: Success metrics (suggested): 80% clinician task completion within median 90s, ingest error rate <0.8%, median inference latency <350ms. Renewal risk triggers: <40% adoption or >3 P1 incidents in 14 days.
Omar: Those targets look fair. Pilot window: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30. Go/no-go at 2026-06-08 after mapping & smoke tests.
Luis: Integration snippet for staging auth (dev only):
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/events \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer STAGING_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"patient_id":"a1","note_text":"follow-up call","ts":"2026-05-28T12:00:00Z"}'
```
Tara: Good. Add item: define fallback model/route if latency spikes >750ms for 5+ min. We want graceful degradation.
Bee: I'll add enablement checklist: clinician invite, quick-reference, recording, feedback form link. Will post draft in #cs-ops by Mon.
Hannah: Sarah requested access to Acadia's SOC2 summary and DPA. Omar, can you share with security channel?
Omar: Uploading contract excerpts & SOC2 to shared folder now.
Tara: @OnboardBot create task "Acadia pilot dataset + mapping" assign: Omar, Luis due: 2026-05-28.
OnboardBot: Task created: "Acadia pilot dataset + mapping" assigned to Omar, Luis. Due 2026-05-28.
Bee: For feedback we'll run a 1-question daily pulse in-app and weekly 15-min interviews. Also capture feature requests in a shared Google Sheet.
Luis: One technical ask: if incoming notes exceed 10KB we'll auto-chunk; will add to integration doc.
Tara: Action recap: 1) Omar share sample data (due 2026-05-28). 2) Luis finalize integration doc + chunking guidelines (due 2026-05-30). 3) Sarah/security to complete intake (ETA 5bd). 4) Bee prep enablement artifacts (draft Mon). 5) Tara publish kickoff playbook & recurring standup invite (today).
Omar: All good. Sending sample earlier if possible. Thanks everyone.
Tara: Thanks team  see you at first standup 2026-05-20 09:00 PT. :sparkles:
